page.layout: One column of running text. Running head at top, page number at top right. Margin note at right beside the lower lines. Signature and catchword at the foot.
page.notes: Page 33 of the book, running head "De Duellis." The margin note at right is set in very small type and reads roughly "Symm. l. 2. Epist. 46", split over three short lines; the abbreviations and the final numeral are uncertain. "semel" is hard to read in the scan and may be "femel" or similar; marked [?]. "misericordé" is printed with an acute accent as shown. The line-end hyphens in "ho-" and "effera-" are printed and carried over. The catchword "tior" is followed by a custos mark, which is not transcribed. The faint marks at the bottom right and the grey edge at the right border are not printed text and were left out.
